title: Religious Court — Source of Power in the Court

entries.value: Renowned for producing miracles and healings
Acknowledged skill in healing or exorcism
Unassailable mastery of doctrine and scripture
Backed by secret but powerful lay supporters
Generous local lay donors fund their position
Has noble or landowning relatives in the area
Expert at persuasion and managing people
Backed by a pious lord who gives lavishly
Secretly arranges worldly services for the court
